scenarios.name: Initial Ingestion
scenarios.description: Ingest known markdown document into isolated index

scenarios.name: Re-ingestion Idempotency
scenarios.description: Re-ingesting unchanged repository produces identical chunks with zero duplicates

scenarios.name: Document Update
scenarios.description: Mutating policy text immediately indexes updated content and drops stale chunks
verified_criteria: Stale text purged from active index

scenarios.name: Superseded Policy Handling
scenarios.description: Active policy preferred over legacy superseded version with identical headings
verified_criteria: Approved evidence contains only active policy

scenarios.name: Document Deletion
scenarios.description: Deleting markdown file clears its chunks completely from index

scenarios.name: Failed Ingestion Containment
scenarios.description: Malformed YAML frontmatter raises FrontmatterParsingError safely without index corruption
verified_criteria: Zero partial or corrupted document states

scenarios.name: Index Rebuild Consistency
scenarios.description: Rebuilding index from source documents reproduces deterministic BM25 scores
verified_criteria: Retrieval scores match to 6 decimal places

scenarios.name: Chunk Boundary Integrity
scenarios.description: Policy statements at doc beginning, middle, and end remain independently retrievable
